key.name: split-view-accelerator
key.description: Keyboard accelerator simulated for the file manager's "Split View" action (3-finger pinch, and middle-click while the file manager is focused). Must match the file manager's own configured shortcut for Split View (Settings > Configure Shortcuts) - GTK accelerator format, e.g. "<Control><Shift>t". Modifier names: Control, Shift, Alt, Super. The trailing key name must match its real GNOME/X11 keysym name exactly (lowercase for plain letters, e.g. "t"; capitalized for named keys, e.g. "Tab", "Page_Up").

key.name: tile-left-accelerator
key.description: Keyboard accelerator simulated for the default 3-finger-swipe-left tiling fallback (any app not specifically overridden). Must match this system's actual "move window to left half" keybinding (org.gnome.mutter.keybindings toggle-tiled-left).

key.name: tile-right-accelerator
key.description: Keyboard accelerator simulated for the default 3-finger-swipe-right tiling fallback (any app not specifically overridden). Must match this system's actual "move window to right half" keybinding (org.gnome.mutter.keybindings toggle-tiled-right).
